summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K notifying the market that on 22 September 2026 it issued and admitted to trading three series of senior unsecured notes under its Debt Issuance Programme: EUR1,000,000,000 Floating Rate Notes due 2030 (ISIN XS3504856603), EUR1,250,000,000 4.431% Fixed to Floating Rate Notes due 2032 (ISIN XS3504856868), and EUR1,500,000,000 4.777% Fixed to Floating Rate Notes due 2037 (ISIN XS3504857080). Listing is on the FCA Official List and LSE Main Market. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, stake, or price-per-share term is involved; this is a routine debt capital markets issuance notice.
